title: Duo Co-Stream
summary: Host + guest split left/right, great for interviews / two-person shows.
notes: Guest view uses Window Capture (WGC) by default; if it won't capture, switch to Display Capture in OBS.

title: Teaching Screen Recording
summary: Display Capture as the base, instructor camera inset + chapter titles, ideal for recording courses.
notes: Captures the main display by default; switch the display index in OBS for multi-monitor setups.

title: Radio Idle
summary: Idle and mic-on scenes for radio / music streams: background, dim overlay, and scrolling track.
notes: Background music loops local audio via ffmpeg; Now Playing can read a text file (OBS text source read_from_file).

settings.text: Night Flight Radio - FM Always On

placeholder.hint: Choose the Now Playing text file (OBS reads it on a timer)
Choose the background music file to loop

title: Go-Live / BRB / End Pack
summary: Countdown, Be Right Back, and end-of-stream screens, with big text ready.
notes: The countdown browser source is hidden by default; unhide it and fill in your countdown page URL when needed.

placeholder.hint: Enter your countdown page URL (hidden by default)

settings.text: That's all for today, see you tomorrow

title: Green Screen Background
summary: Key the subject over a virtual background image, great for gaming, teaching, and stream backgrounds.
notes: The camera must shoot in front of a green screen; without one, remove the Chroma Key filter in OBS and use the camera as a normal shot. Pick the background image, camera, and mic in OBS.

settings.text: Green Screen Live - Welcome to the Stream

title: Selling Dual Camera
summary: Host wide + product closeup dual cameras, with product image and price bar on demand, ideal for live selling.
notes: Needs two cameras (a phone + capture card works as the second). The product image in the Product Closeup scene is hidden by default; just toggle the source visible when needed.

placeholder.hint: Choose the product image to show (hidden by default)

title: Esports Cast
summary: Fullscreen game + caster camera bottom right + score bar, great for event casting and watch parties.
notes: The game view uses Game Capture first and falls back to Display Capture if no window is found; double-click the score bar text to edit it.

placeholder.hint: Choose the game window or display to capture

title: Podcast Talk
summary: Two side-by-side guest cameras + background image, great for interviews, podcasts, and roundtables.
notes: Needs two cameras; you can also set the Guest Camera to Window Capture for a co-stream feed. Pick the background image and devices in OBS.

title: Vertical Short Recording
summary: 9:16 vertical canvas, centered camera + top/bottom title bars, record shorts or go vertical live directly.
notes: Canvas and output are both 1080×1920; ready for vertical short-video platforms. Double-click the top/bottom title text to edit it.

settings.text: Like and follow if you enjoy
Thanks for Watching - See You Next Time

title: Meeting/Class Multicam
summary: Slides fullscreen + speaker PiP + whiteboard camera, great for online classes, demos, and meetings.
notes: Pick the PPT / browser window for the Slide Window with Window Capture; the Whiteboard Closeup needs a second camera or phone mirroring.
